sourceEvidence.label: Privacy hooks, ignore rules, scanner wrappers, workflows, and guidance

assessment.summary: Centralize protected-path and conditional-scanner enforcement with staged-content-bound receipts.

nonNegotiables: Never commit or upload raw scanner reports, OCR text, DICOM values, or matched source values.
Required CI must catch local hook bypass.
assumptions: No scanner latency or memory measurements are available yet.
HoundDog and clinical asset scanners remain local-only unless policy is separately reviewed.

opportunities.title: Bind privacy admission to staged content
opportunities.summary: Use one policy for protected paths, scanner routing, receipts, and reviewed dispositions.
opportunities.diagnosis: Applicability and completion are distributed across prose, hooks, wrappers, and CI filters.

evidence.claim: Blocking and advisory tools are independently routed across hook stages.
Risky artifacts are checked, but required ignore rules are not represented by one policy.
A missing or incomplete HoundDog scan returns success.
Written conditional routing cannot by itself prove execution against staged content.

desiredInvariants: Required ignore rules cannot be removed without a reviewed policy change.
Never-track roots cannot be committed even when force-added.
Required scanner receipts match exact staged blobs and scanner configuration.
Missing, stale, failed, or undisposed scanner results block the applicable boundary.
Required CI evaluates the same policy independently.

options.title: Strengthen guidance and current hooks
options.summary: Clarify routing and add focused checks without content-bound execution proof.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Selected ignore checks catch simple removal.
Wrapper exit semantics can be tightened.
Guidance remains the primary conditional control.

tradeoffs.assessment: Clearer rules reduce mistakes but do not prove tool execution.

tradeoffs.validationPlan: Compare hook timing before and after focused checks.

tradeoffs.assessment: No new model or retained state is introduced.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Confirm focused checks use bounded path metadata.

tradeoffs.assessment: Tighter wrappers reduce ambiguous success while distributed routing remains.
Several policy owners still require coordinated updates.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Audit routing consistency after a synthetic scanner addition.
Run existing hook and CI tests.

workPackages: Clarify routing and protect selected ignore rules.
acceptanceCriteria: Known policy-removal and missing-tool cases are detected.
migrationNotes: Use as the tactical baseline while stronger routing is built.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Revert focused documentation and hook checks.

options.title: Run every scanner on every push
options.summary: Remove conditional routing by making the complete scanner set universal.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: Ignore protection still needs a direct control.
A required universal scan must fail when absent.
Conditional instructions are no longer needed for selection.

tradeoffs.assessment: No relevant change can be misclassified as scanner-inapplicable.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Bypass local hooks and require full CI execution.

tradeoffs.assessment: NLP, OCR, and repository-wide scans join every push path.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure cold and warm full-suite wall time.

tradeoffs.assessment: All scanner models and runtimes may load for unrelated changes.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure peak RSS and model-cache size on each OS.

tradeoffs.assessment: The least portable scanner can block unrelated pushes.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run the full suite on supported operating systems.

tradeoffs.assessment: Every developer and runner needs every scanner dependency.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Test clean setup and offline behavior.

tradeoffs.assessment: Immediate dependency and workflow expansion is required.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Trial in report-only mode before blocking.

residualRisks: Ignore-rule tampering needs a separate gate.

workPackages: Make every scanner portable, pinned, and mandatory.
acceptanceCriteria: Every push completes every scanner or fails.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Restore path-filtered execution while retaining deterministic gates.

options.title: Route conditionally with content-bound receipts
options.summary: Centralize policy and prove expensive scans against exact staged blobs and configuration.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: One policy owns applicability across hooks and CI.
Required-ignore and never-track rules become blocking.
Receipts cannot be created for not-run scanners.
Instructions are backed by deterministic routing and verification.

tradeoffs.assessment: Applicability and successful execution become content/configuration-bound.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Exercise stale, missing, failed, forged-shape, and changed-content receipts.

tradeoffs.assessment: Relative to universal scanning, expensive tools run only for relevant changes.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure routing overhead and per-trigger scan time.

tradeoffs.assessment: Only applicable scanner models need to load.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Measure peak RSS per trigger class.

tradeoffs.assessment: Scoped failures help, but index/receipt state introduces new edge cases.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Test partial staging, renames, worktrees, expiry, and all supported OSes.

tradeoffs.assessment: One policy becomes the routing source of truth, with receipt cleanup and disposition review as new duties.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Add a scanner in a synthetic branch and audit required edits.

tradeoffs.assessment: Trigger families can move from report-only to blocking independently.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Promote one family at a time with rollback drills.

residualRisks: A malicious local maintainer can forge local state.
Public CI cannot reproduce every local-only scanner.

workPackages: Implement protected paths and staged-snapshot routing.
Normalize wrapper exit states and create private receipts.
Add dispositions, CI parity, and synthetic tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Relevant changes require matching successful receipts.
Required CI catches local bypass without exposing values.
migrationNotes: Start report-only and promote each trigger family after calibration.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Disable the affected receipt requirement while retaining deterministic gates and CI scans.

opportunities.recommendation: Use conditional content-bound receipts; retain current controls during incremental rollout.

openQuestions: Which roots are permanently never-track versus inventory-admissible?
Can HoundDog run on a reviewed CI runner, or must it remain local-only?
What receipt expiry is appropriate after scanner timing and update-cadence measurements?
